text:
alex: Quick ask — planning a non-blocking continuous-batching (CB) throughput probe tomorrow 10:00am PT against staging. Need volunteers to kick off, watch queueing, and validate max_tokens behavior. Plan: 5m runs at target QPS with bursts. Anyone available?

maria: I can own the run. Can you paste the exact loadgen flags?

alex: Yep. Example command to run from staging: 
```bash
./loadgen --target staging --duration 300s --qps 200 --payload-template small.json \
  --limit-max-batch 64 --limit-max-tokens 4096 --queue-window-ms 20
```
Also going to toggle `--cb-fallback=small-batch` and `--kv-cache=on`.

sam: What are our primary metrics? throughput only or tail latency + fallback rates?

alex: Both. Primary: stable tokens/s and batching utilization. Check p95/p99 latency and queue-depth histograms. Secondary: model fallback rate and any preemption events.

diana: I can collect traces. Add `--trace-collector diana-traces` and I’ll grab pprof from nodes after the run.

jit: Can we do two sweeps for max_tokens (2048, 4096)? Also include a small-batch ablation with `--limit-max-batch 8` to surface eviction behavior.

maria: Good call. I’ll run a 2048 warmup at 9:30 then the 4096 main at 10:00.

alex: Need someone to watch autoscaler — last time node add was delayed and impacted throughput. @sam can you watch infra?

sam: On it. I’ll monitor the autoscaler and post stackdriver links if anything odd.

loadbot: deploy-bot: Load test scheduled by maria at 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z. Results will be posted to #eng-runtime/results.

ci-bot: perf-bot: Reminder: use the `cb_probe` branch build for the runtime binary to include the preemption metric.

diana: Logging note: grep for `preempted=true` and `fallback=small-batch`. If possible, bump runtime logging to INFO for the window.

alex: After runs, please produce a CSV with: run_id, qps, max_batch, max_tokens, avg_tps, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, fallback_pct. I can PR a small parser if needed.

maria: I’ll generate the CSV. Also pinging @alex for CR on my loadgen wrapper PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/loadgen/pull/142

alex: Will review after the 10:00 run. If we hit a regression rollback plan: set `--cb-fallback=legacy` and reduce `--queue-window-ms` to 5ms.

sam: If autoscaler stalls we can manually scale: 
```bash
infractl scale --pool cb-staging --count +2
```
Don’t do this unless @oncall approves.

jit: Also please capture KV cache hit rate — add header `X-Debug-KV: 1` in the payloads so runtime emits `kv_hit` metrics.

diana: I’ll collect pprof + heap profiles from the runtime pods and drop links here post-run.

maria: Quick checklist for the run:
- [x] prereq: staging binaries uploaded
- [x] warmup run 9:30 (maria)
- [x] main run 10:00 (maria)
- [ ] trace collection (diana)
- [ ] autoscaler watch (sam)
- [ ] CSV + PR (maria + alex)
- [ ] post results to #eng-runtime/results (loadbot)

alex: Tagging postmortem if fallback_pct > 5%. @oncall FYI.

ci-bot: perf-bot: Please confirm when runs start so perf-bot can correlate CI artifacts.

loadbot: deploy-bot: main run started (run_id=20260319-10-main) — runners: 12 clients, target qps=200, duration=300s.

-- 30 minutes later --

loadbot: deploy-bot: run complete: run_id=20260319-10-main — avg_tps=12345, p95_latency_ms=85, p99_latency_ms=128, fallback_pct=0.3%. Results uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/inference/runs/20260319-10-main

diana: Traces + pprof uploaded: https://traces.redwood/inference/20260319-10-main; KV hit rate avg=97.1% on primary pool.

maria: CSV and small summary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/loadgen/pull/143 — CSV attached to pr.

alex: Looks good. No regression. Closing ticket unless anyone sees unexplained preemptions. Thanks all :tada:
